data.name: Stickville
data.detailed_description:
Home is a dumpster in the worst part of a city that already forgot you. It won't get easier from here — but it will get funnier, richer, and a lot more violent.

Stickville is a gritty 2.5D life-sim brawler about clawing your way up from the bottom of a stickman city. No money. No name. No easy way out. Work jobs, run hustles, learn to fight, take risks, and build a life of your own as you make your way from the slums to the top.

🥊 FIGHT LIKE YOU MEAN IT

Real-time melee built around stamina, range, timing, and reading your opponent. Fight with your bare fists, knives, bats, a katana with its own moveset, or even a legendary slam hammer. Learn techniques from back-alley senseis and unlock special moves capable of turning a losing fight around.

💰 PLAY THE CITY

Take a seat at blackjack, roulette, dice, and street hustles. Risk your money, read the table, and know when to walk away. Some games play fair. Others don't. Sometimes the difference between winning and losing is noticing what everyone else missed.

⚙️ TAKE ON THE PITS

Step into fight-night rings, gauntlet ladders, boardroom brawls, and other brutal arenas scattered across Stickville. Push through challenging fights, earn rewards, and keep testing how far your build can take you.

🎁 CHASE THE GOOD STUFF

Earn spins and crack open the city's strongboxes to uncover rare gear, weapons, upgrades, and other rewards. You never quite know what you're going to get — and when that rare drop finally lands, you'll know it was worth the risk.

🏙️ A CITY WITH A BOTTOM AND A TOP

Start in the rain-soaked slums and work your way through the casino strip, Midtown, and the glass towers downtown. Build a home out of a dumpster, fill it with everything you've earned, and watch your surroundings change as your life starts to move upward.

⚖️ CHOICES THAT STICK

Your choices follow you. A karma system tracks the things that actually matter — mercy, integrity, and cruelty. Decide who you want to be, who you help, and how far you're willing to go to get ahead.

🛸 ...AND THEN THERE'S THE THING AT MIDNIGHT

Some nights, the city isn't the strangest thing out there.

Keep your head up.

One street. Every choice. Your life — however you claw it out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU med Vulkan 1.0-support (example NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 / Intel HD 4400)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 Or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

content_descriptors.notes:
Stickville is a gritty crime game set in a stylized stick-figure world, intended for mature players. It contains:

- Violence and blood: Frequent stylized melee and weapon combat (fists, bats, katana, firearms). Defeated enemies bleed, with blood spray on heavy hits and pooling under downed bodies. Some story moments depict characters being killed or executed.
- Illegal drugs: Fictional street drugs ("Stim," "Mellow") can be bought from a dealer and used for in-game effects. The game depicts drug dealing and a run-down drug-den environment. No real substances, chemistry, or usage instructions are shown.
- Alcohol and tobacco: Drinking and smoking are depicted in bars and on the street.
- Simulated gambling: A casino offers slots, roulette, blackjack, and dice. All wagers use in-game currency only — there is no real-money gambling, purchases, or cash-out.
- Crime and strong language: The story involves bribery, theft, shakedowns, and other criminal acts, with frequent strong profanity.

The game contains no sexual content or nudity, no depictions of sexual violence, and no self-harm or suicide. An optional romance storyline exists but nothing sexual is shown.
